items.quote: Direct reports said that Vemon delivered his share of cost savings across procurement reliably.
Several respondents noted that Vemon championed upholding governance and audit standards and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
He took ownership of the team's recovery after a major project setback and steered it to completion.
Peers observed that Vemon Ashington managed the organisational restructuring of the department for his unit.
Vemon managed the move of paper-based permit applications to an online portal for his unit.
Several respondents noted that Vemon championed the partnership with sister agencies on youth services and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
He led service-level targets for frontline operations across the department.
Direct reports said that Vemon Ashington contributed effectively to a ten-year outlook for where the agency should be heading.
Vemon headed dashboards tracking service performance metrics, setting priorities for several teams.
He led the crisis response to a major system outage across the department.
Peers observed that Vemon drove capability building for new hires for the whole division.
Peers observed that Vemon spearheaded stakeholder consultations for the licensing review at the national level.
He was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of the redesign of the citizen journey for permits.
